characterList.description: A male voice, unseen, guiding the tutorial on creating a pixelated sword.
characterList.name: Narrator/Artist

content_metadata.description: This video is a tutorial teaching viewers how to create a pixelated sword, covering topics such as proportions, sketching, color schemes, gradients, and final adjustments. It also encourages creativity and originality in texture pack making.

qAndA.answer: The color picker tool (activated by pressing the K key).
qAndA.question: What tool does the narrator use to select colors from the pre-selected palette?
What keyboard shortcut is used for the "Curves" adjustment tool?

qAndA.answer: The outline effect creates a checkerboard pattern, and removing the unwanted inner pixels cleans up the outline for a more polished look.
qAndA.question: Why does the narrator remove some of the inner pixels after applying the outline effect?

qAndA.answer: The narrator encourages originality to help viewers develop their own unique style and make their texture packs stand out from others.
qAndA.question: What is the main reason the narrator emphasizes originality in texture pack making?

qAndA.answer: The narrator begins with a curious and informative tone as they introduce the topic and demonstrate techniques. By the end, the tone shifts to become more encouraging and motivational, inspiring viewers to apply the learned skills creatively.
qAndA.question: How does the narrator's tone change from the beginning to the end of the video?

activities.description: Introduces the tutorial topic.
Shows a completed sword as an example of proportions.
Outlines the sword's proportions with a green color on a new layer.
Removes the sword details to illustrate the underlying proportions.
Discusses the importance of the blade and handle length relative to the crossguard.

mood.description: The narrator’s enthusiastic introduction and explanation of proportions evoke a sense of curiosity and anticipation for learning how to create the sword.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduction of the topic.
A completed sword is shown as a visual aid for understanding proportions.
Visual demonstration of sword proportions using green outlines.
Simplified outline of sword proportions for clarity.

props.name: Red line tool (to mark center line)

scenes.thematicElements: Importance of proportions in pixel art.
scenes.title: Introduction and Proportions

activities.description: Continues discussing sword proportions and guidelines.
Demonstrates adjusting sword length and crossguard size.
Draws red guidelines for placing the crossguard.
Switches to a new layer and begins sketching the sword outline with black pencil tool.
Briefly assesses the sketched sword shape and adjusts the crossguard length.
Selects and moves the crossguard using M key and arrow keys.
Extends the sword's length by copying and pasting pixels.

mood.description: The visual focus shifts to drawing the sword outline, creating a sense of concentration and active learning.

narrativeProgression.description: Further explanation of proportion guidelines with visual references.
Demonstration of flexibility in sword length and crossguard size.
Drawing specific guidelines for precise placement of the crossguard.
Beginning the actual sketching process using a black pencil tool.
Assessment and minor adjustment of the sketched crossguard.
Fine-tuning the crossguard position for better proportions.
Extending the sword length using copy-paste technique.

scenes.thematicElements: Practical implementation of design principles in pixel art.
scenes.title: Layout and Sketching

activities.description: Introduces the concept of color schemes.
Shows a pre-selected color palette with two shades of green.
Uses the color picker tool (K) to select colors from the palette.
Applies a gradient to the sword using the G key.
Uses the magic wand tool (Shift+S) to select the sword blade.
Demonstrates using Alt key with magic wand for deselecting.
Applies a gradient to the blade.
Applies a gradient to the crossguard, darkening the edges.
Applies a gradient to the pommel.

mood.description: The focus on choosing colors and applying gradients brings a creative element to the scene. The narrator's clear instructions contribute to the informative mood.

narrativeProgression.description: Introduction of color scheme importance.
Presentation of a pre-selected color palette.
Demonstration of color selection using the color picker tool.
First gradient application to demonstrate the tool's functionality.
Selecting the sword blade for applying a more targeted gradient.
Additional tip on using the Alt key for deselecting with the magic wand.
Applying a gradient specifically to the sword blade.
Applying gradients to the crossguard and pommel, emphasizing details.

props.name: Gradient tool (applied to crossguard and pommel)

scenes.thematicElements: Importance of color and gradient in enhancing pixel art.
scenes.title: Color Scheme and Gradient

activities.description: Adds a new layer and selects the sword with the selection tool.
Applies an outline to the sword using "BoltBait's Outline Selection" effect.
Removes unwanted inner pixels using magic wand tool.
Deletes a pixel from the pommel based on personal preference.
Briefly demonstrates adjusting the outline's opacity.
Selects the entire sword to apply color adjustments.
Demonstrates darkening the sword color using Hue/Saturation adjustments (Ctrl+Shift+U).
Demonstrates using "Curves" adjustments (Ctrl+Shift+M) for color manipulation.
Applies "Curves" adjustments to the entire sword.
Fine-tunes the sword color using Hue/Saturation (Ctrl+U) for brightness.

mood.description: The narrator quickly moves through different adjustment techniques, creating a sense of efficiency and focus on practical skills.

narrativeProgression.description: Preparing for outline creation by adding a new layer and selecting the sword.
Application of the outline effect using a specific plugin.
Cleaning up the outline by removing unwanted internal pixels.
Minor detail adjustment based on the artist's preference.
Quick demonstration of opacity adjustment for a less harsh outline.
Preparing for color adjustments by selecting the entire sword.
Demonstrating color darkening using Hue/Saturation adjustments.
Introducing "Curves" adjustments as a more advanced color manipulation tool.
Applying "Curves" adjustments to the whole sword for stylistic effect.
Final color tweaking using Hue/Saturation brightness adjustments.

scenes.thematicElements: Importance of refining details and color in achieving a professional look in pixel art.
scenes.title: Outline and Adjustments

activities.description: Briefly reviews the completed sword and points out details for improvement.
Encourages viewers to experiment with different styles and variations.
Emphasizes the importance of originality in texture pack making.
Concludes the tutorial and encourages subscriptions.

mood.description: The narrator's positive feedback on the completed sword and encouragement to experiment create a motivational tone, inspiring viewers to apply the techniques they’ve learned.

narrativeProgression.description: Brief review of the finished product and suggestions for further refinement.
Encouragement for viewers to explore different styles and create their own variations.
Emphasis on the importance of originality and unique design choices.
Closure of the tutorial and a call to subscribe for more content.

scenes.thematicElements: Importance of creativity and originality in texture pack making.
scenes.title: Conclusion and Encouragement

climax.description: The climax occurs in Scene 4 when the completed sword is shown, underscoring originality, and in Scene 5, where encouragement for creativity is emphasized.

storylines.description: The tutorial disseminates the step-by-step process of creating a pixelated sword while encouraging creative expression and original design in texture pack making.

content_metadata.title: How to Make Packs #2 (Basic Swords)

trimmingSuggestions.description: Trim repetition of outline application method; once demonstrated, viewers understand application across the sword.
Shorten concluding scene by delivering encouragement and closure more concisely.
